scripts.dev:db-up: docker build -t august_postgres . && docker run --name august_postgres -p 5430:5432 -v august_pgdata:/var/lib/postgresql/data --env-file ./.env --shm-size=1g --health-cmd='pg_isready -U user --dbname=postgres' --health-interval=10s --health-timeout=5s --health-retries=5 august_postgres
scripts.dev:db-down: docker stop august_postgres && docker rm august_postgres
